app.name: Salesforce
app.description: Enterprise CRM platform for sales pipeline management, custom objects, and workflow automation.

buildability.primary_blocker: Connected App configuration and OAuth scope permission sets required.

snippets.claim: REST and GraphQL API availability with extensive write capabilities
snippets.quote: The Salesforce REST API lets you integrate with Salesforce applications using standard HTTP methods.

snippets.claim: Free Developer Edition accounts offer self-serve credential creation
snippets.quote: Developer Edition provides a free, full-featured Salesforce environment with API access.

app.name: HubSpot
app.description: Inbound CRM, sales pipeline, and customer lifecycle management software.

snippets.claim: Private Apps allow immediate access token generation without app marketplace approval
snippets.quote: Private apps allow you to use HubSpot's APIs to access your HubSpot account's data via access tokens.

app.name: Twenty
app.description: Modern open-source CRM alternative to Salesforce with GraphQL and REST APIs.

snippets.claim: Open-source architecture provides instant self-serve API keys and GraphQL schema introspection
snippets.quote: Twenty provides both REST and GraphQL APIs authenticated via Bearer tokens generated directly in settings.

app.name: DealCloud
app.description: Vertical CRM and deal management platform for private equity, investment banking, and M&A.

authentication.gating_reason: Enterprise financial services CRM; requires active institutional contract and tenant administrator API key provisioning.

buildability.primary_blocker: Enterprise contract and DealCloud admin provisioning required.

snippets.claim: DealCloud REST API access requires enterprise client credentials issued by Intapp support
snippets.quote: DealCloud APIs provide programmatic access to entries, lists, and relationships authenticated via OAuth 2.0.

app.name: Hootsuite
app.description: Enterprise social media marketing and multi-channel scheduling dashboard.

authentication.gating_reason: Developer portal requires an active enterprise subscription or Hootsuite App Directory partner application.

buildability.primary_blocker: App Directory partner approval and enterprise tier required for API credentials.

snippets.claim: Hootsuite developer account requires partner review or enterprise account linkage
snippets.quote: Access to Hootsuite's APIs requires approval through the Hootsuite Developer Portal.

app.name: Google Ads
app.description: Online advertising platform developed by Google for search, display, and video ads.

authentication.gating_reason: Requires Google Developer Token application approval and Google Cloud OAuth2 credentials.

buildability.primary_blocker: Developer Token review and production access approval by Google Ads API compliance team.

snippets.claim: Developer Token required alongside OAuth2 client ID/secret to make API calls
snippets.quote: To use the Google Ads API, you need a developer token, OAuth2 client ID, client secret, and refresh token.

app.name: Meta Ads
app.description: Digital advertising platform for Instagram and Facebook marketing campaigns.

authentication.gating_reason: Requires Meta App Review, Business Verification, and ads_management permission approval for production.

buildability.primary_blocker: Meta App Review, business verification, and ads_management permission review.

snippets.claim: Marketing API requires App Review and Business Verification for production ads management
snippets.quote: To access live campaign management outside of sandbox test accounts, you must submit your app for App Review.

app.name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
app.description: Enterprise ecommerce platform (B2C/B2B Commerce) offering headless SCAPI endpoints.

authentication.gating_reason: Requires active Salesforce B2C Commerce contract and Account Manager client registration.

buildability.primary_blocker: Enterprise contract and SLAS/Account Manager client ID provisioning required.

snippets.claim: Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI) requires SLAS client credentials provisioned in Business Manager
snippets.quote: To use Salesforce Commerce APIs, developers authenticate using Shopper Login and API Access Service (SLAS) OAuth tokens.

app.name: Amazon SP-API
app.description: Amazon Selling Partner API for seller central inventory, orders, pricing, and fulfillment.

authentication.gating_reason: Requires Professional Selling Account, AWS IAM Role configuration, and Developer Profile approval by Amazon.

buildability.primary_blocker: Amazon Developer Profile approval and AWS IAM role LWA authorization required.

snippets.claim: SP-API requires Login with Amazon (LWA) and AWS Signature Version 4 signing
snippets.quote: To call the Selling Partner API, your app must be authorized by a seller and authenticate with LWA access tokens.

app.name: Airtable
app.description: Low-code platform for building collaborative database applications and workflows.

snippets.claim: Personal Access Tokens with granular read/write and schema scopes
snippets.quote: Personal access tokens allow you to securely grant access to your Airtable data and schema via REST API.

app.name: Stripe
app.description: Payment processing platform and suite of APIs for internet commerce.

snippets.claim: Instant test mode API keys (sk_test_) available upon signup without verification
snippets.quote: Authenticate your API requests by including your secret API key in the request using Authorization: Bearer.

app.name: Paygent Connect
app.description: Japanese payment gateway service by DeNA / Paygent providing credit card and multi-payment APIs.

authentication.gating_reason: Requires merchant corporate contract in Japan, merchant ID verification, and mTLS client certificate authentication.

buildability.primary_blocker: Corporate contract in Japan and mTLS certificate authentication required.

snippets.claim: Paygent Connect module requires merchant contract, static IP whitelisting, and SSL certificate auth
snippets.quote: Paygent API communication requires an assigned Merchant ID, connection password, and client certificate installation.

app.name: iPayX
app.description: Enterprise electronic billing, payment processing, and municipal receivables portal.

authentication.gating_reason: Enterprise government and utility payment gateway; requires formal institutional agreement and VPN/IP whitelisting.

buildability.primary_blocker: Institutional sales onboarding and legacy SOAP/VPN interface.

snippets.claim: iPayX integration requires custom merchant onboarding and private gateway access
snippets.quote: iPayX payment gateway solutions are tailored for institutional billers and require dedicated partner onboarding.

app.name: PitchBook
app.description: Financial data and market intelligence provider covering global VC, PE, and M&A transactions.

authentication.gating_reason: Enterprise institutional data platform; API access requires dedicated Direct Data / API enterprise contract.

buildability.primary_blocker: Enterprise contract ($25k+/yr) and institutional data license required.

snippets.claim: PitchBook Direct Data API requires enterprise subscription and custom API key provisioning
snippets.quote: PitchBook's API provides raw data feeds on companies, deals, investors, and funds directly to enterprise data warehouses.

app.name: NotebookLM
app.description: Google's AI-first personalized research assistant and document grounding notebook.

authentication.gating_reason: Consumer / web-only Google product; lacks public standalone REST API credentials (requires browser automation or internal Gemini APIs).

buildability.primary_blocker: No public developer API or programmatic token generation; consumer web interface only.

snippets.claim: NotebookLM operates as an end-user web application without a public REST API surface
snippets.quote: NotebookLM is an experimental web application. Currently, no public developer API keys or programmatic access points are available.

app.name: Otter AI
app.description: AI meeting assistant for live audio transcription, notes, and collaborative summaries.

authentication.gating_reason: Otter API access is restricted to Otter Business/Enterprise plans and requires enterprise partnership approval.

buildability.primary_blocker: Enterprise contract and Otter partnership developer onboarding required.

snippets.claim: Otter direct API integration requires enterprise tier contract and commercial access approval
snippets.quote: Direct API access for Otter transcription and speech indexing is available on custom enterprise agreements.
